Create a NEW photographic version of the approved scene in reference 1, as if exposed on a 1990s 35mm film SLR using a normal 50mm prime lens at f/2.8. This is a CAMERA / FILM LOOK change, not a change to the date of the depicted story: retain the existing objects, modern smartphones, rooms, clothing, people and actions.
Reference 1 is the approved panoramic photograph letterboxed in a 1536x1024 canvas. Its actual scene is precisely the strip x0..1536 y205..819. Keep that strip's framing and positions as faithfully as possible: key left-eye subject near x390 and right-eye subject near x1130. Output 1536x1024, with the new version of the same panoramic scene inside y205..819. The top and bottom letterbox areas may stay neutral grey. They will be discarded. Do not move a subject above the panoramic strip. Reference 2 is ONLY the game's eye-mask visibility guide: the white areas show where important subject details must remain readable; never render that guide, black eye shapes, actual eyes, borders, or vignette inside the photograph. Keep unimportant background at central seam x768.
LOOK: believable unretouched 1990s consumer color-negative ISO400 still photograph, developed and scanned with restraint. Normal 50mm perspective and gentle optical compression, no ultrawide look, no computer-rendered architectural perfection. At f/2.8 use physically plausible selective focus and natural soft out-of-focus falloff with simple rounded bokeh, NOT fake Gaussian blur or ultra-shallow portrait-mode cutout. Fine irregular silver/colour grain, modest scanner softness, slightly muted greens and blues, skin tones that remain natural rather than orange, gently rolled-off highlights, mildly lifted shadow detail but real blacks. Tiny subtle halation at the brightest practical light only. Ordinary available light and candid snapshot feel, not advertising, not cinematic teal/orange. No added flash unless already motivated by scene. No oversharpening, clarity/HDR, dreamy bloom, gloss, plastic skin, dramatic grading, scratches, dust specks, film borders, timestamps, date stamps or artificial aging. It should look like a real photograph, not a retro filter demonstration.
Luminance contrast and simple silhouettes must still read under the eye mask in grayscale. Keep key subjects in focus and retain enough defocused context to identify each place. No new words, digits, brands, logos or watermarks, EXCEPT the exact pre-existing name "Mom" on Sunday's phone. For people retain believable individual faces, gestures and matte natural skin with restrained pores, lines and incidental asymmetry; do not beautify or turn them into polished AI-stock models. Preserve anatomy and hand count.

mask.prompt:
Generate a production-ready grayscale ALPHA MATTE texture, NOT a picture of eyeballs or a face. The supplied image is the existing two-eye visibility mask for a FIRST-PERSON POV game. White is the open area that reveals the scene; black is hidden. Make it more anatomically plausible and organic than the vector almond shapes, while remaining usable as a clean image mask.
OUTPUT: 1536x1024 image, solid pure BLACK background across entire image. There are exactly TWO solid WHITE openings, side by side, entirely inside the central panoramic band y205..819. Left aperture centered at (395,510), right aperture at (1135,510). Left opening roughly x65..740, right x800..1470. Leave a narrow black bridge around x768. Top and bottom outside y205..819 must remain pure black and empty. Match original composition and keep broad visibility in both eyes. No actual eyes, pupils, irises, sclera shading, skin, skin color, face, nose drawing, eyebrows, text, grids or decoration. Each aperture has a PURE FLAT WHITE interior so scenes show clearly. Only the aperture boundary has a softly defocused organic grayscale falloff, approx 8-15 pixels. Silhouette suggests a photographed view from just behind relaxed human eyelids: uneven upper-lid curvature, tear-duct-shaped inner corners, more horizontal lower lids, tiny natural left-right asymmetry; a FEW very soft and short tapered eyelash occlusions only at upper outer edges, never heavy mascara or hairy fringe. Keep no isolated speckles in white. This is a functional mask like a cinematic POV blink frame, NOT two images of a person's eyes. The two apertures must be recognizably eye-shaped but not geometrically perfect symmetric vector ellipses. VARIANT NATURAL: relaxed open gaze, upper eyelids lightly arched and slightly flattened above the pupil area; lower edge shallow with small organic irregularity. Preserve about the original open area. Subtle realism, not stylized and not sleepy.
mask.processing: Grayscale matte from generated crop; <=5 becomes 0 and >=250 becomes 255; white RGB plus grayscale alpha.
